name: Vex
concept: Twin Fang: the fastest Pressures in the game, the most Starters and Linkers, a low HP and a low grey cap (7): fragile, but there is never much to cash on her. Twin Fang can link into a second Twin Fang; Heel Drop and Hundred Fang end her combos. Specials: Cross-Up (a guard break that starts a combo) and Flying Fang (a fast, Safe thrown blade). Super: Hundred Fang (Dizzy).

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavour: Cover up and build the bar.

cards.name: Cross-Up
cards.flavour: Break the guard and keep going.

cards.name: Flying Fang
cards.flavour: A thrown blade: fast, and nothing to punish.

super.name: Hundred Fang
super.flavour: Once a game: a flurry that leaves them seeing stars.
